definition_zh: 面对单一证据不可靠或缺失，主动汇集多类异源证据（仪器观测、物候记录、文献史料、农谚谚语），以交叉验证互相修正偏差，再从具体现象中抽象出可复用的本质规律，而非仅凭一类材料下结论。
definition_en: When single evidence is unreliable or missing, actively gather heterogeneous sources (instrument records, phenology logs, archives, proverbs), cross-validate them to correct mutual bias, then abstract reusable essential laws from concrete phenomena rather than concluding from one class of material.

formulas: Converge: L = argmax_L Π_k P(x_k | L)   [使多源似然之积最大的规律 L 为归纳结论]
Cross-check: agree(x_i,x_j) ⇒ confidence↑ ; conflict ⇒ flag & reweight   [多源一致升置信，冲突则标红降权]
Span S = union of time/space covered by sources   [证据源并集决定可归纳的时空跨度]
Bias(x_k) ↓ as K↑ and sources independent   [独立源数 K 越多，单源系统偏差越小]

variables.L: 待归纳的本质规律（如近 5000 年气候波动轮廓）
variables.x_k: 第 k 类证据观测值
variables.P_xk_given_L: 在规律 L 下观测到 x_k 的似然

formula_repr.prototype: Inductive abstraction / 抽象归纳法（长尺度多源证据版）

triggers: 关键证据单一、易缺、易伪（古气候/古史/罕见病/冷门市场）
需跨越远超个人寿命的时空尺度才能显规律
文献/民间记录等非标准材料蕴含可用信号
结论需经多方互证才具说服力（学术/司法/尽调）
anti_patterns: 只用一类材料（如仅方志或仅仪器）就断言长周期规律
把文献当「史料」而非「可归纳的实证」弃用
多源冲突时不标红、不重加权，强行缝合
忽略证据时空跨度，把局部结论外推到全局

steps_zh: 广搜异源：系统搜集仪器记录、物候笔记、正史方志、农谚等多类证据，宁多勿漏（竺翻 5000+ 方志）。
定标对齐：为每类证据定时间轴与空间锚点，使跨源可叠加比较。
交叉验证：多源一致则置信上升；冲突则标红、查校勘、按可靠性重加权。
抽象规律：从一致信号中归纳本质轮廓（如温暖期/寒冷期交替、400–800 年小循环）。
外部旁证：引入独立体系（格陵兰冰芯 ¹⁸O/¹⁶O 比）比对，吻合则升置信。
古为今用：把归纳出的周期用于长期预报与当代决策，闭环验证。
steps_en: Broad-source harvest: systematically collect instruments, phenology notes, histories, proverbs—more rather than fewer (Zhu read 5000+ local gazetteers).
Align benchmarks: fix a time axis and spatial anchors per source so cross-source stacking is possible.
Cross-validate: agreement raises confidence; conflict is flagged, re-collated, re-weighted by reliability.
Abstract the law: induce the essential contour from consistent signals (warm/cold alternation, 400–800-yr sub-cycles).
External corroboration: bring an independent system (Greenland ice-core ¹⁸O/¹⁶O ratio) to compare; agreement raises confidence.
Use the past for the present: apply the induced cycles to long-range forecasting and current decisions, closing the loop.
historical_case_zh: 《中国近五千年气候变迁的初步研究》以考古时期（殷墟甲骨、器物）、物候时期（诗经/古籍零碎物候）、方志时期（明以来 5000+ 部方志）、仪器观测时期四阶段证据交叉归纳，勾勒出「仰韶—殷墟温暖 2℃ → 公元前 1000/公元 400/1200/1700 四次冷谷 → 每 400–800 年 0.5–1℃ 小循环」的轮廓；并以格陵兰冰芯氧同位素比印证「气候波动全球性」。竺认为植物分布比动物化石更有效作气候标志，因植物不能移动——此即多源中择优定标的体现。
historical_case_en: 'Preliminary Study on Climate Change in China over the Last 5000 Years' cross-induces from four stages—archaeological (Anyang oracle bones, artifacts), phenological (Shijing and scattered ancient records), gazetteer (5000+ local histories since Ming), and instrumental—to outline 'Yangshao–Yin warm by ~2°C → four cold troughs at 1000 BC / 400 / 1200 / 1700 AD → 0.5–1°C sub-cycles every 400–800 yr'; it corroborates 'global climate oscillation' with Greenland ice-core oxygen-isotope ratios. Zhu held plant distribution a better climate marker than animal fossils because plants cannot move—choosing the best anchor among sources.
modern_case_zh: 尽调/侦破中的「多源交叉验证」：用财报+工商+舆情+供应链访谈互证；医学用影像+血检+病理+基因多模态归纳诊断；AI 训练用多数据集集成降低单集偏差——皆同此模式。
modern_case_en: 'Multi-source cross-validation' in due diligence and investigation: financials + registry + sentiment + supply-chain interviews; medicine fuses imaging + labs + pathology + genomics; AI ensembles cut single-dataset bias—all the same pattern.
inheritance_note: B 级结构同构：对应屠呦呦「文献考据+化学分离+药效验证」三重交叉（模式 25 药学版）、王选「汉字结构抽象归纳」（模式 25 信息结构版）。A 级直链：竺可桢是 Protreptic 中将模式 25 用于「跨 5000 年尺度的历史气候重建」、并把文献史料当可归纳实证的第一人，补强模式 25 高频核心。
reason_zh: 竺可桢将模式 25（抽象归纳法）用于长尺度多源证据交叉：把正史、方志、物候、仪器四类异源材料互证归纳，抽象出可复用的气候规律，是历史科学归纳的标杆。
reason_en: Zhu maps mode 25 (abstract induction) onto long-horizon multi-source evidence: histoires, gazetteers, phenology and instruments are mutually validated and induced into reusable climate laws—a benchmark of historical-science induction.
expected_zh: 在证据稀疏领域产出经多源互证、置信度高、可外部旁证的本质规律，且单源系统偏差被交叉修正显著抑制。
expected_en: In evidence-sparse domains, produce essential laws that are multi-source corroborated, high-confidence, externally corroborable, with single-source bias markedly suppressed by cross-validation.
digital_adaptation: Maps to multi-modal ML fusion, ensemble methods, and knowledge-graph evidence linking.
oral_tradition: 农谚、方志谚谣作为民间证据源
author: serrano
cross_cultural_impact: Applicable to global earth-system science, observation-network design, long-horizon climate reconstruction, and resilience of academic institutions under crisis
education_tradition: Modern science / 现代科学教育（求是书院—浙大传统）
